title: A wide mix of foods makes vitamin and mineral needs easier to meet
summary: WHO says diverse diets, across food groups and within them, are tied to meeting vitamin and mineral needs.
body: The healthy-diet fact sheet of 26 January 2026 says a wide variety of foods, including fruits, vegetables, pulses, whole grains, and lean sources of protein, helps a healthy diet. Diverse diets, based on a wide variety of foods between and within food groups, are associated with a greater likelihood of meeting vitamin and mineral requirements and with a reduced risk of diet-related noncommunicable diseases. The sheet adds that for many adults, a shift toward more plant sources of protein may bring benefits, particularly when the shift is away from red meat. This is an association the sheet states. It is not a guarantee for one eater, and it is not a gram target.
